caption: The drawing depicts an intricately carved wooden architectural element rendered in shades of reddish-brown. The object is vertically oriented and features a prominent decorative lion's head at the upper right, with its open mouth and detailed mane. Below and curving downward from the lion's head is an ornate scrollwork bracket adorned with leaf-like patterns. On the left side, the element includes a turned baluster-like vertical feature, and at the base, there are stepped rectangular moldings. The background is plain and light-colored, emphasizing the complexity and color of the central wooden object. There are no additional objects or details in the background.
title: Mantel Detail
